posts.name: Kritika
posts.cooked:
I had given OPPE of System Commands which was held on 7 December 2024. In that OPPE I was declared pass with 38 marks and according to the grading document I should be given I_OP grade where I will have to retake only the OPPE and BPTs :

image1062×701 41.8 KB

However as I had emailed the support, they answered that I will have to redo the whole semester and I will not be given the I_OP grade.
Please tell me how do I proceed with it now. Will I have to repeat the whole semester again?

posts.name: Somsubhra/সোমশুভ্র
posts.cooked: The grading doc isn’t updated. The course team had mentioned that the revised OPPE cutoff is 35 and not 40.

posts.name: Kritika
posts.cooked: so now i will have to redo the entire semester?

posts.name: Somsubhra/সোমশুভ্র
posts.cooked:
23f1001523:

so now i will have to redo the entire sem

If the cut-off is 35 and you’ve scored 38, why do you have to?

posts.name: Vedant Karia
posts.cooked:
Hi @somsubhra

According to the grading document, if I am:

  1. Absent in OPPE
  2. Present in End Term
  3. T (final score) is >= 35

I should get an I_OP grade which allows me to carry forward my assignment scores, etc and only allow me to retake OPPE next term.

However, I see a U grade for SC on the dashboard despite my final score being 36 (which fits the criteria)

Please confirm if the criteria was updated to “T>40” for this scenario as well so i can know what i need to do for the next term. (and incase there is a mistake here)

posts.name: Vedant Karia
posts.cooked:
Wrong Grade assigned ( U instead of I_OP) System Commands
[image] hi @sayan , found what you mentioned but, the same grading document also suggests that there’s a possibility of getting an I_OP grade despite being absent for OPPE. The document cant be saying two contradictory things at once and expect us to understand, hence seeking clarification. i have a similar case. Absent for OPPE but T>35. So i was expecting an I_OP but here i am with a U grade unclear on which instruction to follow. Please help clear out the confusion and rectify the document…
